----Petitioner Versus State of Rajasthan, through PP
----Respondent For Petitioner(s) : Mr. Ratan Kumar Kaushik Dr. Abhinav Sharma with Mr. Akshaya Verma & Ms. Sanchita Pareek
For Respondent(s) : Mr. Jitendra Singh Rathore, PP with Ms. Neha Goyal HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE ANAND SHARMA (V. J.) Order 10/06/2025 1.

These bail applications have been filed by the petitioners under Section 483 of BNSS in respect of FIR No. 313/2024 [2025:RJ-JP:23008] (2 of 3) [CRLMB-5733/2025] registered at Police Station Jhotwara, District Jaipur West for the offences punishable under Sections 420, 406, 467, 468, 471 &
120-B of IPC.

entities.text: Police Station Jhotwara, District Jaipur West
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: 2. Learned counsel for the petitioners submits that the petitioners have not been named in FIR.
The FIR has been lodged against three persons with the allegations that they have forged documents in order to avail loan facility to different persons.

Learned counsel further submits that the accused-petitioners before this Court are the persons who have taken loan with valid documents and have been repaying their loan regularly without causing any default whatsoever.
Counsel also submits that the petitioners are behind the bars since long time.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Therefore, the petitioners may be allowed to enlarge on bail.
3. Learned Public Prosecutor has vehemently opposed these bail applications.

4. Considered the submissions made at Bar.
5.

Taking into consideration, the overall facts and circumstances of the case, this Court without expressing any opinion on the merits and demerits of the case, deems just and proper to enlarge the petitioners on bail.
6. Accordingly, these Bail Applications are hereby allowed.

The accused-petitioners Jaspal Singh S/o Shri Ramkaran & Vijay Kumar Sharma S/o Lt. Shri Ghanshyam Das Sharma shall be released on bail in pursuance of FIR No. 313/2024 registered at Police Station Jhotwara, District Jaipur West on furnishing personal [2025:RJ-JP:23008] (3 of 3) [CRLMB-5733/2025] bond of Rs. 1,00,000/-
along with two sureties of the like amount.

entities.text: Police Station Jhotwara, District Jaipur West
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text:
That apart, the accused-petitioners shall also follow the conditions as under:-
(i) They shall not tamper with any evidence, nor would influence the witnesses in the case.
(ii) They shall not leave the country without prior permission of the Court.
(iii) They shall co-operate in the trial and shall attend each and every date of hearing in the trial, until and unless his presence is exempted by the trial Court.
7. Office is directed to place a copy of this order in connected case file.

(ANAND SHARMA (V. J.)),J DIVYA /32-33 Powered by TCPDF (www.tcpdf.org)
